# components


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Plain tags need no helper: `Button`, `A`, `Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`,
`Table`, `Dialog`, `Details`, `Progress`, `Meter` and the headings are
styled as they are. A `Div` has no look of its own; give it a class
(`card`, `row`, `hstack`, `vstack`, `container`) or use the functions
below. An accordion is plain `Details(Summary('Title'), P('Body'))`.

``` python
assert '--min:10rem' in to_xml(Grid('a', 'b', col_min='10rem')) and to_xml(Grid('a')).count('<div>') == 1
assert 'class="col-8 offset-2"' in to_xml(Column(span=8, offset=2)) and 'class="row"' in to_xml(Row())
assert 'closedby="any"' in to_xml(DialogX('b', id='d')) and 'closedby="none"' in to_xml(DialogX('b', closedby='none'))
assert 'method="dialog"' in to_xml(DialogX('b', form=True))
```

``` python
s = to_xml(Sidebar(Ul(Li(A('Home', href='/'))), P('main'), topnav=SidebarToggle()))
assert 'data-sidebar-layout' in s and 'data-sidebar' in s and 'data-topnav' in s and 'data-sidebar-toggle' in s
```

## Page chrome and the reader’s controls

The controls carry `data-set="key=value"` or `data-cycle="key:a,b,c"`;
fhoat.js handles the clicks, so there is no inline script and a strict
CSP still works. Each control takes your own `icon`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/fhoat/blob/main/fhoat/components.py#L214"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

``` python
    brand, *links, end:NoneType=None, href:str='/', cls:str='', **kw
)->fastcore.xml.FT:
```

*A sticky glass bar: brand, links as (text, href) or FT, then `end`
items (default: the mode toggle).*

``` python
p = to_xml(ThemePicker())
assert p.count('data-set="theme=') == len(THEMES) and 'data-set="radius=lg"' in p and 'onclick' not in p
assert 'data-cycle="mode:auto,dark,light"' in to_xml(ModeToggle(order=('auto', 'dark', 'light'))) and 'data-cycle="size:,lg,sm"' in to_xml(FontToggle(('', 'lg', 'sm')))
assert 'class="ot-nav"' in to_xml(Navbar('B', ('Docs', '/d'))) and 'href="/d"' in to_xml(Navbar('B', ('Docs', '/d')))
```

## Toasts

[`OatToast`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/components.html#oattoast)
shows a toast where it lands: in a page or an htmx swap.
[`toast_hdr`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/components.html#toast_hdr)
shows one after an htmx request, through `HX-Trigger`.
[`setup_oat_toasts`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fhoat/components.html#setup_oat_toasts)
makes FastHTML’s own `add_toast(sess, msg, typ)` show Oat’s toasts.


*A script that shows a toast: `variant` info|success|warning|danger;
opts `placement`, `duration`.*

``` python
s = to_xml(OatToast('</script><script>alert(1)</script>'))
assert '</script><script>' not in s.removesuffix('</script>') and '\\u003c/script' in s
assert json.loads(toast_hdr('Saved', 'Done', 'error', events=dict(refresh=1)).v)['toast']['variant'] == 'danger'
```

``` python
from fhoat.core import fast_app
from fasthtml.toaster import add_toast
app, rt = fast_app()
setup_oat_toasts(app)
@rt
def index(sess): add_toast(sess, 'Hi', 'success'); return P('x')
from starlette.testclient import TestClient
assert '"variant": "success"' in TestClient(app).get('/').text
```
